title: BreadSticks
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Pani (Water) ½ Cup or as required

steps.instruction: In lukewarm milk,add sugar,instant yeast and mix well,cover and let it rest for 10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Neem garam doodh mein cheeni aur khameer dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker 10 minutes kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add all-purpose flour,dry milk powder,salt and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein maida,dry milk powder aur namak dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add dissolve yeast mixture and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dissolve khameer ka mixture dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add water and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka pani shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cooking oil and knead well.
steps.romanUrdu: Cooking oil dal ker ache tarhan ghond lein.

steps.instruction: Add all-purpose flour and knead until smooth dough is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: Maida dal dein aur ghond ker smooth dough tayyar ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cooking oil and knead again,cover and let it rest for 1 hour or until double in size (warm place).
steps.romanUrdu: Cooking oil dal ker dubara ghond lein aur dhak ker 1 hour ya size double hunay tak garam jagha per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Knead dough again then divide dough into 14-15 strips (7 inches) and shape each into a uniform roll or long breadsticks.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ko dubara ghond ker 14-15 strips( 7 inches) mein divide ker lein aur her strips ko uniform roll ya long breadstick ki shape bana lein.

steps.instruction: On baking tray,lined with butter paper,place prepared bread sticks.
steps.romanUrdu: Baking tray per butter paper laga ker tayyar breadsticks rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In egg white,add water and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Anday ki safeedi mein pani dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Brush breadsticks with egg white+water and sprinkle sesame seeds.
steps.romanUrdu: Breadsticks per brush ki madad sa anday ki safeedi+pani laga lein aur safed til chirak dein.

steps.instruction: Bake in preheated oven at 180 C for 18-20 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Preheated oven mein 180 C per 18-20 minutes kliya bake ker lein.

ogDescription: Make and store bread sticks, they go well with soups or you can give them to kids for on the go munching #HappyCookingToYou
